title: 第10章 斩龙河
slug: 修罗天尊全本免费-修罗天尊最新章节列表
content_zh:
雷电劈空，余音隆隆，似要击开这昏暗的天空，使光明重现！
“龙河，你没死？！”无天抬头，拨开额前那湿漉漉的头发，黑宝石般的眸子，带着无尽的悲恸，深处一缕杀机疯狂涌现，声音冰冷刺骨。
如果不是眼前人，爷爷不会死，村人也不会死，村子更不会湮灭，所有的一切都是他一手造成的！
龙河没有说话，他被火世控制，如今只是一具傀儡，行尸走肉，意识已不存在，只剩下躯壳，甚至割一块肉，碎一块骨，也不会让他疼痛，毫无知觉！
“火世给了你什么好处，值得你出卖相处了十几年的村人，几十村民一朝惨死，死无全尸，他们死不瞑目啊，你良心何在？！！”
此刻，无天已被怒火冲昏了头脑，没有注意到龙河的异样，见其神情冰冷，一步一步走来，只当是利欲熏心，冥顽不灵，他的杀意更甚。
将怀中白骨轻轻的放在地上，像是呵护婴儿般，动作很柔，这是爷爷留下唯一的东西，存在的证明，不能损坏。
“爷爷，龙河是第一个，孙儿斩了他为你陪葬，不，他没资格陪葬，只配沦为野兽腹中食。”无天细心擦拭白骨上的水渍与黑灰，他要斩杀这个泯灭天良的人！
小天趴在他头上，狭长的眸子仇视着对面，凶光湛湛，跃跃欲试，上次龙河将无天打入悬崖，至今它还记得，这个人是必杀的对象。
无天阻止了它，没有让它出手，因为这是他的战斗，代表龙村所有人的战斗，他要为死去的村人与爷爷，斩掉此人，祭悼惨死的亡魂！
“轰！”
一步踏出，泥水四溅，被雨水冲刷的地面，裂出几道口子。借助这贯力，无天弹跳而起，体内精气滚滚而动，五指紧握成拳，咔嚓作响，散发着白光。
一出手，无天就动用了精气，包裹了拳头，威力大增。
他不得不这么做，一是龙河修为太高，尽管废去一只手臂废去，但论实战经验，无法与之相比，这让无天很忌惮。二是，爷爷的血仇，村子的惨景，使他的心愤怒到极点，近乎失去理智，只知倾尽全力，杀眼前人。
拳头光华流转，宛如一轮小月亮，释放着惊人的凌厉，无天俯冲而下，暴怒轰去，这个地方，雨水被蒸发，他已经将力量发挥到巅峰！
龙河站在那里，没有情绪，没有心跳，散发的气息像是一个死人，没有一丝生命迹象，空洞的眸子如两口黑洞，很吓人。
这时候，他动了，速度很快，形同鬼魅般，瞬息而至，抬起青色的大手，没有精气涌出，仅凭肉身的力量，与拳头碰在了一起。
并没有可怕的气浪卷起，但无天却连连后退，地面上留下一个个寸深的脚印，他身躯一震，双脚施力，深陷泥土，勉强稳住了身形。
他心惊，境界的差距果然不是外力可以弥补，龙河已经残废一只手，实力却还如此强，且没动用精气，就有如此程度，对轰一拳，竟丝毫没有移动，着实可怕！
“仅有一只手能用，无惧！”

无天的身形再动，双脚不着地，暴掠而去。手掌如刀，光芒绽放，如月华附体，将他衬托的无比神圣。
与诸多妖兽厮杀一个月，逃命是经常的事，故而他的速度提升了一大截，此刻这苦修的成果，终于展现了出来。
龙河像是死神般，眼神冷漠，看着冲来的身影，吐出两个生硬的字：“活捉！”
“活捉？！你要活捉我？为了火世活捉我？你…真是丧心病狂，无可救药。”无天大怒，气海内精气翻滚，犹如潮流般，汹涌而出。
暴怒的一掌，直接对着龙河的面门拍去，精气喷薄，光芒璀璨，犹如一片神兵划过，这里成了虚空地带，雨水不再落下，停滞当空。
后退一步，龙河两腿交错，划出一片轨迹，从容避开，而后五指摊开，如同鹰爪般，对无天脑袋抓去，迅疾而凶猛！
“主人吩咐要活捉。”他喃喃一声，去势一变，抓向无天肩膀，欲将他生擒。
被练成傀儡的人，不具备意识，只懂得遵守主人的吩咐，按照指令行事，不过这样一来，使无天有了充裕的时间脱身，并给予反击。
就在这刹那间，无天身体微侧，险之又险的避开攻击，而后那精气流转的手掌，有着可怕的锐利，反手劈去。
“砰”的一声，无天脚下踉跄，倒退几步。这一掌着实劈中了龙河的腋下，他想将其这只手也废掉，到时必是实力大减，毙命就简单多了。

content_en:
Thunder and lightning split the sky, with lingering rumbles, as if they were about to break open the dark sky and bring light back!
"Long He, you're not dead?!" Wu Tian raised his head, brushing away the wet hair from his forehead. His black jewel-like eyes were filled with endless grief, and a murderous intention emerged crazily from deep in his voice. His voice was cold and bone-chilling.
If it hadn't been for the person in front of him, grandpa would not have died, the villagers would not have died, and the village would not have been annihilated. Everything was caused by him!
Long He did not speak. He was controlled by the Fire World. Now he is just a puppet, a walking corpse. His consciousness no longer exists, only the body is left. Even cutting a piece of flesh and breaking a piece of bone will not cause him pain. He has no consciousness!
"What benefits has the Fire World given you that are worth betraying the villagers you have been with for more than ten years? Dozens of villagers died tragically in one day without any body parts. They died with their eyes open. Where is your conscience?!"
At this moment, Wu Tian was blinded by anger and did not notice the strangeness of Long He. Seeing his cold expression and walking step by step, he thought he was greedy and stubborn, and his murderous intention was even worse.
He gently placed the bones in his arms on the ground, as if caring for a baby, with very gentle movements. This is the only thing left by grandpa, a proof of existence, and cannot be damaged.
"Grandpa, Long He is the first one. My grandson beheaded him to bury him with you. No, he is not qualified to be buried with you. He only deserves to be eaten in the belly of wild beasts." Wutian carefully wiped the water stains and black ash on the bones. He wanted to kill this man who had no conscience!
Xiaotian lay on his head, glaring at the opposite side with his narrow eyes, fierce and eager to try. The last time Long He knocked Wutian into the cliff, he still remembers that this person is the target of death.
Wu Tian stopped it and didn't let it take action, because this was his battle, a battle on behalf of everyone in Long Village. He wanted to kill this person and mourn the tragic death of the villagers and grandfather!
"Boom!"
As soon as he took a step forward, mud and water splashed everywhere, and there were several cracks in the ground washed by the rain. With the help of this force, Wutian jumped up, the energy in his body was rolling, his five fingers clenched into a fist, making a clicking sound, emitting white light.
As soon as he made a move, Wutian used his energy to wrap his fist, greatly increasing its power.
He had to do this. First, Long He's cultivation level was too high. Even though one of his arms was crippled, his actual combat experience was incomparable. This made Wu Tian very afraid. Second, his grandfather's blood feud and the tragic scene in the village made him so angry that he almost lost his mind. He only wanted to use all his strength to kill the people in front of him.
The brilliance of his fist flowed like a small moon, releasing an astonishing force. Wutian swooped down and blasted away with fury. In this place, the rainwater was evaporated, and he had already exerted his power to its peak!
Long He stood there with no emotion or heartbeat. He exuded the aura of a dead person without any sign of life. His empty eyes were like two black holes, which was very scary.
At this time, he moved, very fast, like a ghost, and arrived in an instant. He raised his big green hand, without any energy flowing out, and only relied on the strength of his physical body to touch his fist.
There was no terrifying air wave, but Wutian continued to retreat, leaving inch-deep footprints on the ground. His body shook, and he exerted force on his feet, sinking deeply into the soil, and barely able to stabilize his body.
He was shocked. The gap in realms could not be made up by external force. Long He had already disabled one of his hands, but he was still so strong. He did not use his energy to such an extent. He punched Todoroki and did not move at all. It was really scary!
"You only have one hand to use, so don't be afraid!"
Wutian's figure moved again, his feet did not touch the ground, and he flew away violently. The palm of his hand is like a knife, and the light blooms, like the moonlight possessing it, making him look extremely sacred.
After fighting with many monsters for a month, escaping for his life was a common thing, so his speed increased a lot. At this moment, the results of his hard work were finally revealed.
Long He looked like a god of death with cold eyes. He looked at the approaching figure and uttered two blunt words: "Capture alive!"
"Captured alive? ! Do you want to capture me alive? Capture me alive for the Fire World? You...are so insane and hopeless. "Wutian was furious, and the essence in the sea of ​​qi rolled and surged out like a tidal wave.
A furious palm was slapped directly at Long He's face. The essence spurted out and the light was bright, like a divine weapon passing by. The place became a void area, and the rain stopped falling and stagnated in the sky.
Taking a step back, Long He crossed his legs and drew a trajectory, avoiding it calmly. Then he spread out his five fingers, like an eagle's claws, and grabbed Wu Tian's head, quickly and fiercely!
“The master ordered that he be captured alive. "He murmured, changed his posture, and grabbed Wu Tian's shoulder, trying to capture him alive.
People trained as puppets have no consciousness and only know how to obey their master's instructions and act according to the instructions. However, this gives Wutian plenty of time to escape and fight back.
At this moment, Wu Tian turned his body slightly, narrowly avoiding the attack, and then the palm with the flowing energy was terrifyingly sharp, and he struck back with a backhand.
With a "bang", Wutian stumbled and took a few steps back. This palm really hit Long He's armpit. He wanted to destroy this hand, but then his strength would be greatly reduced, and death would be much easier.
